verdict.rationale: Unleash documents only one-off, time-based actions: releasing a feature at a specific date via a currentTime/DATE_AFTER constraint, and applying grouped change requests at a specific point in time. Its metric-driven milestone progression automates a rollout, but it is not a recurring schedule. Nothing in the pack shows recurring or cron-style jobs or workflows, and one-off scheduling is not a substitute for a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
